description.zh:
实例ID。
> 当本参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，还需要传入**NodeId**参数。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> **NodeId** is required when specifying a sharded cluster instance ID

description.zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.
The data granularity of the performance metrics in seconds. Valid values: 5, 30, 60, 600, 1800, 3600, and 86400.

description.zh:
性能指标，取值详情请参见[监控项说明](~~216973~~)。

>如需传入多个指标请用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en:
The performance metrics. For more information, see [Metrics](~~216973~~).

> To specify multiple metrics, separate them with commas (,).

description.zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID或Shard节点ID，可用于查询单个节点的性能情况。

> 当**DBInstanceId**参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数才可用。
description.en:
The ID of a mongos or shard node in the sharded cluster instance. This parameter lets you query the performance of a single node.

> Available only when **DBInstanceId** is set to the ID of a sharded cluster instance.

description.zh:
单节点实例或副本集实例的节点角色，取值说明：
- **Primary**：主节点。
- **Secondary**：从节点。

> - 当**DBInstanceId**参数传入的是单节点实例ID或副本集实例ID时，本参数才可用。
> - 当**DBInstanceId**参数传入的是单节点实例时，本参数的取值仅支持**Primary**。
description.en:
The role of a node in a standalone or replica set instance. Valid values:

- **Primary**: The primary node.

- **Secondary**: A secondary node.

> * Available only when **DBInstanceId** is set to the ID of a standalone or replica set instance.
>
> * If **DBInstanceId** is set to the ID of a standalone instance, this parameter only supports the value **Primary**.

description.zh:
单节点实例或副本集实例的节点角色ID。您可以通过调用[DescribeReplicaSetRole](~~62134~~)接口查询。
> 当**DBInstanceId**参数传入的是单节点实例ID或副本集实例ID时，本参数才可用。
description.en:
The role ID of a node in a standalone or replica set instance. To query the role ID, call the [DescribeReplicaSetRole](~~62134~~) operation.

> Available only when **DBInstanceId** is set to the ID of a standalone or replica set instance.

description.zh:
Search节点ID。
> - 当实例开通Search功能后，本参数才可用。
description.en:
The Search node ID.

> Available only after the Search feature is enabled for the instance.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-db-instance-performance --db-instance-id dds-bp26350000 --node-id d-bp22870000 --key CpuUsage --start-time 2022-06-13T10:58Z --end-time 2022-06-13T11:58Z --role-id 60250000 --interval 60 --replica-set-role Primary --search-id dds-2zec12675c9e0000-search --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds DescribeDBInstancePerformance --region cn-hangzhou --ReplicaSetRole Primary --SearchId 'dds-2zec12675c9e0000-search' --EndTime '2022-06-13T11:58Z' --DBInstanceId 'dds-bp26350000' --NodeId 'd-bp22870000' --StartTime '2022-06-13T10:58Z' --RoleId 60250000 --Key CpuUsage --Interval 60
